```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(polite)
library(purrr)
```




```{r}
robotstxt::paths_allowed("https://www.who.int/data/gho/data/indicators")
```


```{r}
session <- bow("https://www.who.int/data/gho/data/themes/topics/indicator-groups/indicator-group-details/GHO/malaria-cases", force = TRUE)

result <- scrape(session) |>
  html_nodes(css = "table") |> 
  html_table(header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
result
```


```{r}
malaria <- read_html("https://www.who.int/data/gho/data/indicators")

# 2: html_nodes()
tables <- html_nodes(malaria, css = "table") |>
html_table(tables, header = TRUE, fill = TRUE) 
```
